brief.symptom: problems.md DT-123: one offer_posted payload is kept across items (the cheapest), so the offer of a marked item can be lost
evidence: src/GameServer/Bot/Population/ColdSimulationKernel.js stepWake (kept = cheaper payload regardless of itemId)

cause.explanation: when two offers for different items reach one bot before its step, the dearer item's offer_posted payload is replaced, so a quote mark on that item is not cleared and the bot keeps skipping a seller it could use

closed.evidence: scratchpad/dt123/proof.js: offer_posted payload read by nothing
